description: Ranked-tier registry of repos with discovered latent value. Build-out follows promotion into this list.

value_repos.value_thesis: Only repo in the estate expressing documentation quality as a machine-readable, versioned contract (5 YAML schemas + 100-point rubric + 6 templates), already consumed by essay-pipeline and public-process. Highest latent value: a reusable docs-quality standard the whole eight-organ estate could adopt once enforcement is co-located with the schema.
value_repos.first_task: Ship a standalone, dependency-light frontmatter + quality validator (validate.py CLI + reusable GitHub composite action) that reads schemas/frontmatter-schema.yaml, reconciling the README/schema field drift in the same pass, so any estate repo can gate its docs on the same contract in CI.
